observations.behavior: Replaces a single static button with a mapped list of starter buttons; each entry uses the supplied title and description.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds four predefined worksheet starters to the BI Starters UI. This could help users quickly launch common analyses without manually configuring queries.

observations.behavior: Defines an array of starter objects, each specifying id, title, description, and a pre-built BI query configuration (e.g., daily events, distinct people, ranked by reach).
observations.posthog_connection: These configurations establish shared starting points for business intelligence worksheets, potentially reducing setup time and standardizing common use cases.

observations.behavior: Tests that all generated question starters share a fixed seven-day date range and lack SQL snapshots, while preserving source and row definitions.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression checks for the new starter behavior, including assertions on date ranges, absence of cached results, and correct event aggregation or filtering.

observations.limitations: Only documentation and frontend changes are provided; no backend implementation, warehouse connector updates, or tests for actual execution and result rendering are shown. The tier depends entirely on whether these starters can be executed end-to-end.

review.reason: The change adds substantive bounded capability: four predefined worksheet starters with complete query configurations and UI wiring. Tests check their construction and URL parameters. This is not systemic risk reduction across components, so it does not meet tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Adds reusable entry points to Business Intelligence worksheets, which could help users perform routine analyses without manual query building.
review.uncertainty: Without backend and test execution evidence, benefit remains conjectural.
